messages:
toni: Publish to us-east ECR failed validation during today's release window. deploybot rejected manifest due to missing 'org.redwood.builder' annotation. :frowning:

deploy-bot: automated: Publish rejected for us-ecr.redwood/service-d@sha256:bb77aa: provenance lint: missing required annotation 'org.redwood.builder'. See logs: /logs/1795000000

asher: that's surprising, CI just finished and cosign attestations are present. Could this be a registry-side acceptance delay?

toni: Attempted republish with same build output but registry skipped duplicate manifest -> no new digest. So republish won't fix it.

maya: mitigation: pin staging to previous digest sha256:ccddee for the release window and lock the pipeline. We'll rebuild to get a new digest with correct annotations.

release-manager: Decision: hold the release window and pin staging/service-d to sha256:ccddee. If rebuild doesn't finish within 60m, escalate to infra.

asher: running: `deploybot lock job=service-d-pipeline reason="missing builder annotation"`

deploy-bot: automated: Lock applied for job=service-d-pipeline by asher. Auto-promote disabled.

asher: `deploybot pin route=staging/service-d digest=sha256:ccddee note="pin during republish"`

deploy-bot: automated: Route staging/service-d pinned to sha256:ccddee by asher. Pin expires in 24h.

maya: rebuild started with annotation injection. ETA ~18m. Also opening ticket INF-498 to add pre-publish lint for required annotations.

toni: note for release notes: "Staging held; pinned to previous digest due to image metadata validation failure. Republish in progress."

asher: rebuild complete. New image digest sha256:dd44ff published. Validation passed. Promotion still locked; manual promote required.

maya: starting canary 2% -> 10m. Monitoring: https://dash/service-d/canary

release-manager: Canary healthy at +9m. Proceed to full promote and remove pin. Unlock job afterwards.

asher: `deploybot unpin route=staging/service-d` && `deploybot unlock job=service-d-pipeline`

deploy-bot: automated: Route staging/service-d unpinned by asher. Job service-d-pipeline unlocked.

maya: updating release history and closing the hold. Follow-up: INF-498 for pre-publish lint and a CI test to fail fast on missing annotations.

toni: thanks team, closing thread once release notes live.
